# Release Notes

## 0.45.0 - 2026-10-22 (deployed and activated)

PR #79 merged. Production run `39856350519` deployed runtime SHA `ff56d579f8c6c87823b3d168edc41146fd4569f4` after main validation `39855084011`; readback passed at `2026-10-22T21:25:38.536968+00:00` (2026-10-23 00:25 UTC+03:00). Approved activation `39857647888` and separate status readback passed: `enabled=true`, `all_images_enabled=true`, six readiness flags true.

Adds all-user private capture from PWA photos, Telegram photos and image documents before recognition gates, and original administrator Telegram documents with user ID, status and a bounded result. Private 1 GiB quota, 10 MiB file bound, at-most-seven-day retention, durable paused outbox, bounded retries, direct-PostgreSQL session mutex and account-deletion cleanup are active. Delivery is at-least-once, not exactly-once; delivered Telegram copies are not automatically retracted. Financial confirmation remains required.

Authenticated production smoke on 2026-10-23 used PWA, Telegram image-document and Telegram photo inputs. The administrator notification log showed three `recognition_photo` rows with `Sent` status and sent-at UI times `00:52`, `01:09` and `01:31`. These are application-recorded Telegram `sendDocument` acknowledgements, not recipient-side downloads or byte-hash verification. Recognition failed for the synthetic smoke image; no financial confirmation was clicked. Provider accuracy, production financial-row-count invariance and private analyst retrieval were not established. Earlier receipt-quality, real-device, browser-login and course/partner acceptance gaps remain unchanged.

Formal delivery CLI readiness remains `INCOMPLETE`: the original named `python ops/recognition_quality_browser_acceptance.py --server` route is local/synthetic and has no production-target evidence. Production retention/deletion/retry fault-injection was not performed. Documentation-only sync does not change the active runtime SHA or imply another rollout.
